title: Cold rebuild: twelve endpoints in parallel
summary: Check slow endpoints concurrently, politely and in order, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Doing many things at once* you checked twelve slow endpoints in parallel. Do it again from memory: the same
checks, **no hints, no solution**. This check and the boss prove the module.

steps.prompt: In what order do results come out of `ForEach-Object -Parallel`?
options: In the order the items finish
steps.explain: Each runspace outputs when it is done. Sort afterwards if the order matters.

steps.title: Twelve endpoints in parallel, cold
prompt: Write `~/scripts/check-endpoints.ps1`: call the 12 URLs in `~/scripts/endpoints.txt` in parallel (the API allows 8
at once), print `<id> ok` or `<id> failed` per endpoint sorted by id, in under 6 seconds.
From memory: no hints this time.
